cues.text:
This is Evelyn Academy — a complete learning platform,
under your brand.

Every lesson is taught live,
by an AI voice tutor.
Here's the tutor, mid-lesson.
Here we've got a right triangle,
with the right angle sitting at point B.

That's the relationship: the sum of the squares
of the two legs
equals the square of the hypotenuse.
That means AC squared equals 25,
so AC itself is 5 — the hypotenuse.

Every objective has practice, quizzes
and a unit test —
and review is flagged the moment it's due.
Timed mock exams, scored by unit —
and reviewed with the tutor.
You see what each learner has mastered,
and exactly where they're stuck.
One platform.
Your name, your colors, your courses.

And your team sees every learner,
every session, every replay.
Bring your syllabus. We'll build your academy.
evelynlearning.com
